title.value: NL-PS-L1-B - Level 1b: Maximum metadata and empty sections - Patient id

description.value: The serving system provides an NL-PS for its level 1b test patient, in which all metadata is present, and all mandatory sections are empty, with an emptyReason and a narrative. Metadata covers the Composition and the Patient, Practitioner, PractitionerRole, Device and Organization in the document; per type, one filled resource is enough. A missing SHALL:populate element fails, a missing SHOULD:populate-if-known element gives a warning. Known issue: of the Organization obligations only name is SHALL; the other SHALL:populate obligations in the profile are treated as SHOULD:populate-if-known. Conformancelab searches the Patient Summary of the Patient id you enter at test setup. Enter the id of your level 1b test patient, without 'Patient/'. Implementation Guides: NL-PS https://ig.nictiz.nl/nlps/ and generic building blocks (GBB) https://ig.nictiz.nl/gbb/
